scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @cardverse/web" "npm run dev -w @cardverse/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cardverse/shared && npm run build -w @cardverse/web && npm run build -w @cardverse/server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @cardverse/web && npm run lint -w @cardverse/server && npm run lint -w @cardverse/shared
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @cardverse/web && npm run typecheck -w @cardverse/server && npm run typecheck -w @cardverse/shared
scripts.test: npm run test -w @cardverse/shared && npm run test -w @cardverse/server
